text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024. July 24, 2024 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to address City Council for a presentation in recognition of City staff who assisted in the response to flooding on July 16, 2024. Mayor Chow thanked all City staff and agencies who responded to the needs of residents to restore vital services quickly and efficiently, after the City received more than a month’s worth of rain in a matter of hours flooding many areas of the City. City Manager Paul Johnson addressed City Council and remarked on dealing with the emergency and managing continuity of work within City Hall and within the community.
